**What it's for:** every uploaded/signed onboarding document across the whole roster, grouped by
employee, with a link to view each document AND its signature page (if signed online). Search by
name/ID/email. Export the metadata table (Excel/PDF/Send) or download a bulk ZIP of the actual
files (one employee, or everyone at once).

**When to open a ticket:** the page shows "not ready" / an orange banner, or a document that's
clearly uploaded doesn't show a working "View" link.
pages.support_md:
**Data sources:** `GET /hr/onboarding/compliance-documents` (+`/export` for the ZIP). Reads ONLY
`storeops.employee_onboarding` (document metadata/status) — it **never** reads
`employee_onboarding_profile.intake_data` (the Fernet-encrypted PII table), so nothing here can leak
SSN/bank data even via export.

**Symptom → diagnosis → fix**
- *Orange banner "Run migration 073..."*: means onboarding isn't activated for this tenant yet — no
  documents can exist until then; this is a genuine pending-setup state, not a display bug.
- *`ready:false` with a specific error message*: the backend now returns an explicit error instead of
  a silent empty list on a failed read — read that message rather than assuming "just empty."
- *A document shows "no file" but the employee insists they uploaded it*: check the per-document row
  for a **file_index "(1 of 2)"** style label — migration 402 made multi-file tasks show one row per
  file; if they uploaded to a DIFFERENT task than expected, it'll show under a different document
  label. Also check `/hr/onboarding/{employeeId}` → "Orphaned files" recovery tool for files that got
  detached from their task by a pre-fix bug.
- *"View" link opens nothing / errors*: for a legacy (pre-402) row this falls back to a
  "most recent file" endpoint — if multiple files exist and the wrong one was expected, check the
  employee's own onboarding page for the full file list instead.

**Escalate when:** `ready:false` persists with an error message that isn't "run migration 073" (a
genuine backend/storage error) — escalate to platform operator with the exact error text.

common_issues.symptom: Page shows an orange 'run migration 073' banner
common_issues.diagnosis: Onboarding isn't activated for this tenant yet.
common_issues.fix: No support-side fix — flag for platform operator to run the pending migration for this tenant.
common_issues.escalate_when: Always, if HR confirms they expect onboarding to already be active.

common_issues.symptom: An employee's uploaded document shows 'no file' here
common_issues.diagnosis: Check the employee's own onboarding detail page (/hr/onboarding/{employeeId}) — the file may be attached to a different task, or be an 'orphaned file' from a pre-fix bug.
common_issues.fix: Use the Orphaned Files recovery tool on the employee's onboarding page to re-attach it to the correct task.
common_issues.escalate_when: No orphaned file is found and the employee has proof (e.g. a confirmation) that the upload succeeded.

pages.title: Onboarding Checklist (admin)
pages.user_md:
**What it's for:** four tabs — **Documents** (per-employee sent/pending/returned board),
**Completed** (fully-back packets ready for HR review), **Reconcile mandatory docs** (find gaps),
and **Checklist setup** (the CONFIGURABLE template: categories → items, each with an owner role
[Employee/HR/DM/Market Manager], an optional doc link or uploaded template/completed-sample file,
mandatory vs. optional, and a work-authorization "blocking" flag). Also configures the structured
**intake form fields** (personal/address/tax/direct-deposit/etc.) that propagate to employees.

**Key behavior:** a **fillable PDF (AcroForm)** an employee uploads is auto-checked for
completeness — if the form itself marks required fields empty, the document is **auto-flipped to
"returned"** with the exact missing fields listed (shown to the employee AND emailed), instead of
silently sitting as "submitted."

**When to open a ticket:** a checklist item edit doesn't show up for new hires, or an uploaded PDF
was auto-returned and HR believes it's actually complete.
pages.support_md:
**Data sources:** `GET /hr/onboarding/template`, `/categories`, `/tasks`, `/tasks/{id}/template`,
`/tasks/{id}/sample`, `/intake-fields` (CRUD). AcroForm completeness check lives in
`hr/router.py` `_pdf_completeness_check` (reads the PDF's own `/AcroForm` dictionary for
fields marked required and empty).

**Symptom → diagnosis → fix**
- *A document was auto-returned but HR is sure it's actually filled out correctly*: open the
  employee's onboarding page (`/hr/onboarding/{employeeId}`) — the `missing_fields` list shown there
  is exactly what the PDF's own form flagged as empty+required; if the PDF was filled with a
  non-AcroForm tool (e.g. flattened/printed-and-scanned), the check may not "see" typed values the
  same way a form-filler does. HR can still manually mark it verified after reviewing the actual
  file.
- *New/edited checklist item not appearing for a hire already in progress*: the template only
  applies items that were active AT THE TIME the employee's checklist was generated (or as
  re-synced) — a mid-flight employee may not automatically pick up a brand-new item; check the
  employee's own onboarding page to confirm.
- *Intake field change doesn't show on the employee's own form*: intake fields propagate to
  employees — confirm the field's `is_active` flag and that it's not been accidentally scoped to a
  state (`applies_state`) that doesn't match this employee's work state.
- *"Run migration 073" banner*: same activation gate as `/hr/compliance` — this tenant's onboarding
  isn't turned on yet.

**Escalate when:** the AcroForm check auto-returns a document HR has personally confirmed is 100%
correctly filled out (not a display/interpretation issue) — escalate to platform operator with the
exact PDF for review (possible form-field-detection gap).

common_issues.symptom: A submitted PDF got auto-flipped to 'Returned for fixes' but looks complete
common_issues.diagnosis: The PDF's own AcroForm fields marked required may be empty even if the visible text looks filled (e.g. it was flattened/printed then scanned back in, losing the fillable fields).
common_issues.fix: Open the employee's onboarding page to see the exact missing_fields list; if genuinely filled, HR can manually verify/override after reviewing the actual file.
common_issues.escalate_when: The exact fields listed as missing are visibly filled in the PDF viewer — likely a form-detection gap, escalate to platform operator with the file.

common_issues.symptom: A newly added checklist item doesn't show for an employee already mid-onboarding
common_issues.diagnosis: Checklist items may only apply to newly-generated checklists, not retroactively to in-progress ones.
common_issues.fix: Check that employee's own onboarding page; if truly missing, there's no in-app 'resync' button — escalate.
common_issues.escalate_when: Confirmed missing on the employee's own page and needs to appear.

related_settings: Work-state per employee (drives which state-specific tasks apply)

pages.title: Employee Onboarding (one hire)
pages.user_md:
**What it's for:** one new hire's full onboarding record — checklist status per item (pending /
submitted / verified / returned / N/A), document view/upload/delete, work-state selector, a
credential-less QR/link an employee scans to fill their own forms pre-start, workflow-stage advance
(invited → in_progress → docs_submitted → docs_verified → provisioned → active), the encrypted
sensitive-field **Reveal** panel, and an audit-trail event log.

**Reveal is HR/admin-only and every reveal is logged to the audit trail.** Never share, screenshot,
or repeat revealed PII outside this page.

**When to open a ticket:** a document shows "returned" and the employee needs to know exactly what's
missing, or Reveal doesn't work / errors.
pages.support_md:
**Data sources:** `GET /hr/onboarding/employee/{id}`, `/events` (audit), `/sensitive` (Reveal, HR/admin
gated + audited), `POST .../invite`, `/advance`, `/task/{id}/return`, `/orphaned-files` +
`/reattach-orphan` (recovery for a pre-mig-402 bug that detached files from their task on re-upload).
PII lives Fernet-encrypted in `employee_onboarding_profile.intake_data`
(`FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY`) — **losing that key is unrecoverable; never rotate it as a side effect of
anything.**

**Symptom → diagnosis → fix**
- *"Returned" item — what does the employee need to fix?*: the `missing_fields` list (or
  `returned_reason` for a manually-returned item) is shown right on this page; relay that EXACT list
  to the employee rather than a general "please redo it."
- *Reveal button does nothing / errors*: confirms the caller is actually HR/admin — a lesser role has
  no access to `/sensitive`, by design. If the caller IS HR/admin and it still fails, check network
  errors (not a permissions problem at that point).
- *A once-uploaded file seems to have vanished after a re-upload*: check **"Orphaned files"** on this
  page — a pre-migration-402 bug detached (not destroyed) overwritten files; they can be found by
  filename and re-attached to the correct task here.
- *Workflow can't advance to "provisioned"/"active"*: a task marked **work-authorization / blocking**
  (⛔ in Checklist setup) must be complete first — the advance call itself explains which
  compliance requirement is unmet, with an optional override (reason required, separately audited).
- *QR/invite link says expired or doesn't load*: check the token's `expires_at` — link invites are
  time-boxed; regenerate a new invite from this page.

**Escalate when:** `/sensitive` (Reveal) errors for a confirmed HR/admin user (not a permissions
issue), or the Fernet-encrypted data appears corrupted/unreadable — treat as a PII-handling
emergency, escalate immediately, do not attempt any workaround.

common_issues.symptom: Employee's document is marked 'Returned' and they don't know what to fix
common_issues.diagnosis: The missing_fields list (or returned_reason) is shown right on this page.
common_issues.fix: Relay the exact listed fields/reason to the employee — don't paraphrase to a vague 'redo it.'
common_issues.escalate_when: N/A — this is self-service info on the page.

common_issues.symptom: A file the employee uploaded seems to have disappeared after replacing it
common_issues.diagnosis: Check the Orphaned Files tool on this page — a known pre-fix bug detached (not deleted) overwritten files.
common_issues.fix: Find the file by name in Orphaned Files and re-attach it to the correct task.
common_issues.escalate_when: File isn't found in Orphaned Files either — possible genuine data loss, escalate to platform operator.

common_issues.symptom: Reveal (sensitive PII) fails for an HR/admin user
common_issues.diagnosis: Confirm the user truly has HR/admin role — otherwise this is access-control working as intended.
common_issues.fix: None — do not attempt to bypass the gate.
common_issues.escalate_when: Confirmed HR/admin and it still errors — treat as urgent, this touches the encryption key path.

related_settings: FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY (never rotate as a side effect — unrecoverable if lost)

pages.title: Payroll Expenses (employer burden)
pages.user_md:
**What it's for:** configure and run the employer-side payroll burden — **Payroll Tax** (auto-computed
FICA Social Security + Medicare + FUTA + SUTA, only the rates are editable) and **Payroll Expense
Items** (fully custom line items like Unemployment Insurance / Workers Comp — add your own). Running
a period rolls everything into ONE additive "Payroll Expenses" line on the Store Expenses page.

**This is money-adjacent (employer cost / expense reporting) — treat rate changes as propose-first,
not a routine tweak.**

**When to open a ticket:** the computed totals don't match expectations for a known wage figure, or
"Run" doesn't push the line to Store Expenses.
pages.support_md:
**Data sources:** `GET/PUT /storeops/payroll-tax-config`, `GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE
/storeops/payroll-expense-items`, `GET /storeops/payroll-expenses/{period}`,
`POST /storeops/payroll-expenses/run/{period}`. Backend `payroll_expenses.py`, migration 404.

**Symptom → diagnosis → fix**
- *Item total looks wrong*: check its `calc_method` (% of wages / $ per $100 of wages / $ per
  employee headcount / flat $) and `scope` (per-store vs. company-wide allocated by wage share) — a
  misconfigured method/scope is the most common cause of an unexpected number, not a math bug.
- *"Run" for a period doesn't seem to update Store Expenses*: confirm the period format
  (`YYYY-MM`) matches what Store Expenses expects, and check `last_run_at` on this page updated —
  if it did, the expense line should be there; if it silently didn't update `last_run_at`, that's a
  genuine issue.

**Escalate when:** any rate/item change is being requested that would alter reported employer cost
numbers — this is money-touching and needs the owner's explicit yes before wiring, per the money
guardrail; also escalate any computed total that's wrong even with correct-looking config.

common_issues.symptom: A payroll expense item's computed dollar amount looks wrong
common_issues.diagnosis: Check calc_method (pct_wages / per_100_wages / per_employee / fixed) and scope (store vs company-wide) — these drive very different totals for the same rate number.
common_issues.fix: Correct the calc_method/scope if misconfigured; this is a config check, not a bug fix.
common_issues.escalate_when: calc_method and scope are both correct and the total is still wrong — money-adjacent, escalate.

common_issues.symptom: Wants to change a payroll tax rate or add a new payroll expense item
common_issues.diagnosis: N/A — this is a request, not a bug.
common_issues.fix: This is money-touching (propose-first) territory — do not make the change unilaterally even though the UI allows it.
common_issues.escalate_when: Always get explicit owner sign-off before changing rates that affect reported employer cost.

related_settings: Custom payroll expense items (calc method, scope, rate)

pages.title: HR · People
pages.user_md:
**What it's for:** the single front door to **add a person** — creates the StoreOps roster row (with
a stable employee_id) and, if given an email + role, assigns the RBAC role and optionally
provisions a login and/or sends an onboarding invite, all in one action. Also supports inviting an
**existing** employee (no-login DOB-gated link, or a portal login) and bulk-inviting everyone
incomplete.

**When to open a ticket:** a newly added person doesn't show up on Schedule/Payroll/other pages, or
an onboarding invite email never arrives.
pages.support_md:
**Data sources:** `POST /hr/employees` (creates + optionally assigns role/login/invite in one call),
`GET /hr/employees`, `POST /hr/onboarding/employee/{id}/invite`, `/hr/onboarding/invite-bulk`.
Everything keys off `employee_id`, which is why adding someone HERE makes them appear everywhere
(scheduling/payroll/org/commissions) — adding a person only on, say, StoreOps Admin without an
employee_id can leave gaps elsewhere.

**Symptom → diagnosis → fix**
- *New person doesn't show up on Schedule/Payroll*: confirm they were actually marked `is_active`
  and have a `home_store` (or at least one store in "Stores covered") — an employee with no store
  association won't appear in store-scoped pickers.
- *Invite email never arrives*: the response message distinguishes "invite emailed" from
  "invite ready — send manually" (email not configured) from "invite issue" (an actual failure) —
  check which of those three the on-screen message actually said before assuming it's broken.
- *"Full login now" checked but no temp password shown*: only appears when `create_login` is ticked
  AND an email was given — without an email, a login can't be created at all (validated client-side
  first).
- *Bulk "Invite all for onboarding" reports fewer emailed than invited*: some employees' email isn't
  configured — the message says "some emails not configured — see per-employee tracker for links,"
  meaning HR must hand those specific people their link manually from their own onboarding page.

**Escalate when:** an invite shows "emailed ✓" in the UI but the recipient never receives anything
(and it's not in spam) — escalate to platform operator (notify/email delivery, `mod-platform-core`
owned).

common_issues.symptom: Onboarding invite says 'emailed' but the employee never got it
common_issues.diagnosis: Check spam first; if truly nothing arrived despite an 'emailed ✓' confirmation, this is likely an email-delivery infrastructure issue.
common_issues.fix: Manually share the onboarding link/QR from that employee's onboarding detail page as a stopgap.
common_issues.escalate_when: Confirmed not in spam and 'emailed' was shown — escalate to platform operator (notify/email module).

common_issues.symptom: New employee doesn't appear on Schedule or Payroll
common_issues.diagnosis: Check is_active flag and that at least one store (home_store or store_codes) is set.
common_issues.fix: Edit the employee record (StoreOps Employees or this page) to set is_active + a store.
common_issues.escalate_when: is_active and store are both set correctly and they still don't appear.

related_settings: Store roster (for home store / stores covered)

pages.title: Sign in
pages.user_md:
## Signing in to MetricsPro

Go to **https://metricspro-five.vercel.app** (this is the ONLY app address — bookmark it) and sign in with your work email + password.

What you may see after entering your password:

- **Choose a company** — your login works for more than one company. Pick the one to work in; you can switch anytime from the company switcher in the top bar.
- **Verify it's you (6-digit code)** — your company requires two-factor sign-in. A code is sent automatically to your email or WhatsApp. Tick "Remember this device for 30 days" to skip this on your own device. Use "Resend code" or "Use email instead" if it doesn't arrive.
- **Connect a company** — another company invited your email. Enter the access code your administrator gave you to connect it to this login. If it's the wrong account, the expandable option gives you a brand-new separate login instead (your current login gets disabled — only MetricsPro support can restore it, so be sure). "Not now" defers the invite.
- **Set your password** — first login or after an admin reset: choose a new password that meets your company's rules.

**Forgot your password?** Click "Forgot password?", enter your email, and you'll get a 6-digit reset code by email (if the account exists). Enter the code + a new password.

**When to raise a ticket:** "No access yet" or "Access disabled" screens (your admin controls these), a code that never arrives after several resends, or being locked out after switching logins.
pages.support_md:
## How it works

        Auth = Supabase email/password (`supabase.auth.signInWithPassword`). After sign-in, the frontend AuthProvider loads the profile (`/api/v1/core/bootstrap`, falling back to auth-config → my-tenants → pending-connections → `/core/me`) and redirects to the role's home (`safeHomeFor(permissions)` from rbac.ts). Screens in priority order: tenant picker (multi-tenant login, `needsTenantChoice`) → 2FA OTP (`needs2fa`; verify mints an `x-2fa-token`) → pending connect-invite panel → stuck screen ("No access yet" = not provisioned / "Access disabled" = `is_active` off) → password-reset redirect (`must_reset_password`).


**Login problems checklist (run in this order):**

1. **Which URL are they on?** The app URL is ONLY `https://metricspro-five.vercel.app`. `metricspro.tech` is email-only — its web host is DEAD (parked IP, times out). ALWAYS ask which URL before debugging anything else on a "site won't load" report.
2. **Wrong password / unknown email** — Supabase returns a generic sign-in error. Use "Forgot password?" (self-serve OTP by email) or have an admin reset it (Roles & Access "Resend" / Security Settings "Set an employee's password" / super-admin at /admin/tenants).
3. **"No access yet" ("Account not set up")** — the login EXISTS but no role is assigned in this tenant. Fix: a company admin assigns a role at /admin/roles (Assign people tab) — a role assignment IS the app_users row.
4. **"Access disabled"** — the account's `is_active` was turned off (deactivated). Fix: an admin reactivates the person at /admin/roles, or escalate if the login itself was disabled during an account-link switch (disabled-login reinstatement is SUPER-ADMIN ONLY, via support@metricspro.tech or a helpdesk ticket).
5. **Tenant picker appears** — the login belongs to MORE THAN ONE company. That is normal: pick one; switch later with the company switcher (x-active-org) in the top bar.
6. **2FA code screen** — the tenant/user requires a one-time code (per-tenant policy, default OFF). Code auto-sends; "Resend code" and "Use email instead" are on the screen; "Remember this device" skips it for 30 days.
7. **Redirected to /account/password** — `must_reset_password` is set (fresh invite / admin reset). They must set a policy-compliant password before entering the app.


        Multi-tenant: one login can belong to several tenants. The chosen tenant rides every request as the **x-active-org** header — a hint only; the backend middleware re-derives membership from the JWT (MULTI_TENANT_ENFORCE=1 live since 2026-07-04). Forgot-password is anti-enumeration: the request step ALWAYS returns the same generic message whether or not the account exists — never tell a caller "that email isn't registered" based on this flow.


**Account-linking privacy (hard rule):** NEVER disclose cross-tenant relationships. Do not confirm or deny that an email exists in another company, is invited elsewhere, or belongs to several tenants — not to admins, not to the user's manager, not in error messages. Invites are consent-based: the invited USER connects the company (with an access code) at their own login screen. If someone chose "Disable old login & start fresh", the old login can only be reinstated by a MetricsPro super-admin via support@metricspro.tech or the helpdesk.


        2FA is a per-tenant policy (default OFF, configured at /admin/security): off / optional / required, channels email and/or WhatsApp, optionally only for specific roles. Email OTP delivery is confirmed working (Resend); WhatsApp send-validity is NOT live-confirmed — if a WhatsApp code never arrives, have the user press "Use email instead" and note the WhatsApp issue.

        ## Symptom → diagnosis → fix

        - "Site won't load / times out" → they are on metricspro.tech (dead web host) → send them to metricspro-five.vercel.app.
        - "No access yet" → login exists, no role in this tenant → admin assigns role at /admin/roles.
        - "Access disabled" → `is_active` off → admin reactivates at /admin/roles; if disabled via disable-and-switch, super-admin reinstatement only.
        - 2FA code never arrives (email) → check spam; resend from the screen; if still nothing, check /failures and the /notify Send History → escalate to platform operator (Resend/env issue).
        - Login accepted but blank/stuck page → have them hard-refresh; check /failures for a Reference id; escalate with the id if reproducible.

common_issues.symptom: User says the site won't load or times out
common_issues.diagnosis: They are browsing metricspro.tech — that domain is email-only; its web host is dead (parked IP). Always ask which URL first.
common_issues.fix: Point them to https://metricspro-five.vercel.app and have them re-bookmark it.
common_issues.escalate_when: metricspro-five.vercel.app itself is down for multiple users (platform operator checks Vercel/Railway status).

common_issues.symptom: "No access yet" / account not set up after signing in
common_issues.diagnosis: The login exists in Supabase but no role is assigned in this tenant (no app_users row / no role).
common_issues.fix: A company admin opens /admin/roles → Assign people, sets the person's email + role, and saves. The user signs out and back in.
common_issues.escalate_when: A role IS assigned and the screen persists after re-login — platform operator checks the app_users row / org membership.

common_issues.symptom: "Access disabled" after signing in
common_issues.diagnosis: The account's is_active flag is off (deactivated by an admin, or the login was disabled during an account-link 'start fresh' switch).
common_issues.fix: Admin reactivates the person at /admin/roles (edit → active). If the LOGIN was disabled via disable-and-switch, only a MetricsPro super-admin can reinstate it — route via support@metricspro.tech or a helpdesk ticket.
common_issues.escalate_when: Reinstatement of a disabled login is requested — always super-admin only.

common_issues.symptom: 2FA code never arrives
common_issues.diagnosis: Channel problem: email may be in spam or Resend misconfigured; WhatsApp delivery is not live-confirmed platform-wide.
common_issues.fix: Use 'Resend code' then 'Use email instead'. Check spam. Admin can review /notify Send History and /failures.
common_issues.escalate_when: Email codes also fail (RESEND_API_KEY / NOTIFY_FROM_EMAIL env on Railway = platform operator).

common_issues.symptom: User expected to land in the app but sees a company picker
common_issues.diagnosis: Their login belongs to more than one tenant — this is by design.
common_issues.fix: Pick the company to work in; switch later via the top-bar company switcher. Do NOT discuss which other tenants an email belongs to with anyone but the user themself.
common_issues.escalate_when: Picker shows a company the user says they never consented to connect — super-admin reviews the audit trail.

pages.permissions_needed: Public page (pre-auth). The post-login screens depend on the account's provisioning, role, tenant memberships, and the tenant 2FA policy.

pages.title: Notify (recipients, subscriptions, send history)
pages.user_md:
## Notify

Manages report delivery by email and WhatsApp. On-demand sending lives on each report page ("Send" button); this page manages the saved pieces:

- **Subscriptions:** schedule a report (daily/weekly/monthly at an hour + timezone) with filters, channels (Email/WhatsApp), formats (Excel/PDF), and recipients (saved ones + ad-hoc emails/phones). Toggle active, delete, see next/last run.
- **Recipients:** the saved address book — add manually or promote from the employee roster.
- **Send History:** every send with status and (for WhatsApp) a Delivery column — delivered/read = confirmed on the handset; a WhatsApp row stuck on "sent" was accepted by Meta but never confirmed delivered.
- **Settings:** how long WhatsApp no-login download links stay valid (1–90 days).

A yellow banner on top means a channel isn't configured platform-side.

**When to ticket:** scheduled reports stop arriving, or every send fails.
pages.support_md:
## How it works

Backend `notify/router.py`: recipients/subscriptions/send-log CRUD, `/notify/health` (env presence), `/notify/send-file` (used by every report's Send button per the report-export doctrine), `/notify/send`, and `POST /notify/run-due` — the scheduler entrypoint. **Scheduling is Supabase pg_cron calling run-due with an `x-notify-secret` header; a 403 means the header doesn't match Railway `NOTIFY_RUN_SECRET`** (this exact mismatch caused the historical "sweeps idle" incident — pg_cron fired fine all along; check `net._http_response` for the real status; `net.http_post` is async). Do NOT manually fire run-due repeatedly — a backlog can 502.

**Channel status (support facts):** Email = Resend, from reports@metricspro.tech — CONFIRMED working, and it's global (one key for every tenant). WhatsApp (Meta) — configured, but send-validity UNCONFIRMED: Meta can accept a message (status 'sent') and silently drop it; the Delivery column exposes this (delivered/read green vs stuck-on-sent amber). Treat email as the reliable channel; log WhatsApp anomalies rather than promising fixes.

## Symptom → diagnosis → fix

- Banner "Email (Resend) not configured" → RESEND_API_KEY / NOTIFY_FROM_EMAIL missing on Railway → platform operator.
- Banner "WhatsApp not configured" → WHATSAPP_* env vars / Meta template → platform operator.
- Subscriptions never fire (next_run passes, no send-log rows) → pg_cron → run-due 403 secret mismatch, or the cron job missing → platform operator verifies NOTIFY_RUN_SECRET + cron.job.
- Email says sent but not received → check Send History status + recipient spam; Resend-side issues = operator.
- WhatsApp status 'sent', Delivery blank forever → accepted-then-dropped by Meta → resend via email; note the pattern.
- Send fails for one subscription only → bad filters (e.g. period spelling) or empty recipients → edit the subscription.

common_issues.symptom: All scheduled reports stopped arriving
common_issues.diagnosis: pg_cron hits POST /notify/run-due; a NOTIFY_RUN_SECRET mismatch returns 403 silently (visible only in Supabase net._http_response).
common_issues.fix: Support confirms subscriptions are active and next_run_at is in the past; nothing else is UI-fixable.
common_issues.escalate_when: Immediately — secret/env/cron verification is platform-operator work. Do not mass-fire run-due manually.

common_issues.symptom: WhatsApp report never reaches the phone though history says 'sent'
common_issues.diagnosis: 'sent' = accepted by Meta only; Delivery column stuck empty/amber = silently dropped (known Meta behavior with certain links).
common_issues.fix: Re-send via email channel; keep the send-log row as evidence.
common_issues.escalate_when: Pattern is consistent — platform operator (Meta template/webhook work); WhatsApp send-validity is not fully confirmed platform-wide.

common_issues.symptom: Download link in a WhatsApp message expired
common_issues.diagnosis: No-login links expire per the Settings tab (default 7 days).
common_issues.fix: Raise the expiry (1–90 days) and re-send the report.
common_issues.escalate_when: Links 404 immediately on fresh sends.

common_issues.symptom: Cannot edit the Settings tab
common_issues.diagnosis: Notify settings writes are permission-gated (notify_policy setting area).
common_issues.fix: Grant the notify settings area on the role at /admin/roles.
common_issues.escalate_when: 403 persists for a company admin.

pages.permissions_needed: Notify module on the role. Settings tab writes additionally need the notify settings area grant.

pages.title: Report Recipients (per-report routing)
pages.user_md:
## Report Recipients

ONE page to set who each report goes to. Per report: pick saved recipients, add ad-hoc emails/phones, choose channels (email/WhatsApp), toggle active, Save — then "Send now" tests the routing immediately. Any module's "send to the designated person" feature reads this config.

Add people to the saved recipients list on the main Notify page first.

**When to ticket:** "Send now" reports failures for a correctly configured row.
pages.support_md:
## How it works

`GET /notify/report-config` (registry of routable report keys + current routing), `PUT /notify/report-config/{report_key}`, and `POST /notify/send-to-designated {report_key}` — modules call the same endpoint for their "send to designated" buttons. A row that was never saved shows unconfigured; send-to-designated for it returns a 'skipped' notice rather than failing.

## Symptom → diagnosis → fix

- "Send now" returns skipped → row inactive or no recipients resolved → save recipients + active.
- Sent count 0 / failed >0 → channel-level failure → check the Notify Send History row for the error (then email-vs-WhatsApp guidance from the /notify doc applies).
- A module's "send to designated" does nothing → that report_key not configured here → configure + Save.

common_issues.symptom: Daily module alert going to the wrong person
common_issues.diagnosis: Routing rows here override/feed designated sends per report_key.
common_issues.fix: Update the row's recipients and Save; verify with Send now.
common_issues.escalate_when: Save succeeds but sends keep using stale recipients.

pages.title: Kiosk (mobile time clock + dashboard)
pages.user_md:
**What it's for:** the employee-facing mobile kiosk — sign in, clock in/out with a selfie
face-match, see your own dashboard/reports/chargebacks, and (My Team tab) a manager's team snapshot.

**Clock-in eligibility:** you can clock in at your **home store**, any store you're **scheduled** at
today, or a store you're set up to **float** to — otherwise a manager must approve a one-time
**override** (which also adds a shift for you and clocks you in).

**What you'll see if the server is slow/busy (fixed 2026-07-22):** instead of a blank frozen screen,
the kiosk now shows an honest message — either *"Can't reach the MetricsPro server... this screen
retries automatically"* (server unreachable) or *"Couldn't load your account... retrying
automatically"* (profile didn't load yet) — and keeps retrying on its own. If a clock-in/out attempt
times out, you'll see *"the server didn't respond — your clock-in may NOT have gone through. Wait
for your status above to refresh before trying again"* — **do not repeatedly tap clock-in** on a
timeout; check your status first (a double-clock-in on an already-open punch will be rejected).

**When to open a ticket:** the retry message keeps showing for several minutes with no recovery, or
you get a face-match rejection you're sure is wrong.
pages.support_md:
**Data sources:** Supabase auth session, `GET /storeops/timeclock/status|allowed-stores|config|face`,
`POST /storeops/timeclock/clock-in|clock-out|override`. Face match uses face-api.js
(TinyFaceDetector + FaceLandmark68Tiny + FaceRecognitionNet loaded from a CDN) — a
Euclidean-distance compare against the enrolled descriptor, cutoff = tenant's
`face_match_threshold` (default 0.60, tenant-configurable 0.45–0.72 on the Failure Logs page;
**higher = looser = fewer false rejects**). A rejected match **auto-logs a `face_mismatch` row to
Failure Logs** with the best-match % and threshold used, plus a how-to-fix note.

**2026-07-22 kiosk night-resilience fix** — every API call on this page now carries an
`AbortSignal.timeout(...)` (client.ts helper `tsig`) so a saturated backend can't leave the screen
frozen with nothing on it; a "server unreachable" vs. "profile didn't load" vs. "punch may not have
landed" message replaces the old blank screen, and status/profile/allowed-stores polling
self-heals (retries every 12–15s) once the connection error clears — **no manual page reload
required**, though one is always safe.

**Symptom → diagnosis → fix**
- *Kiosk shows a blank/frozen screen with no message*: should no longer happen post-fix — if a user
  reports this AFTER 2026-07-22, it's a regression; get the exact device/browser and screenshot.
- *"Can't reach the MetricsPro server" / "Couldn't load your account"*: transient backend
  busy/restart — the page retries on its own; if it clears within a minute or two this is expected
  behavior during a deploy or traffic spike, not a bug to escalate.
- *Face match rejected for the right person*: check Failure Logs for the `face_mismatch` entry — it
  records the best-match % vs. the threshold used. If legitimate reps are rejected often, the
  tenant's threshold may be too strict (raise it, within 0.45–0.72, on Failure Logs) rather than
  re-registering everyone repeatedly.
- *"You're at a store you're not scheduled for" style prompt*: normal — this employee isn't at their
  home/scheduled/floater store today; a manager must use the on-screen **override** flow (verifies
  the MANAGER's own password on a throwaway session, then authorizes the punch — it doesn't sign the
  manager into the kiosk).
- *A clock-in/out timed out — is it in or not?*: the app deliberately does NOT auto-retry a timed-out
  punch (a blind retry could 409 on an already-open punch) — check the on-screen status ("on the
  clock since...") before trying again.
- *Employee's login isn't linked to an employee record (403)*: an admin needs to set their Employee
  ID in **Roles & Access**.

**Escalate when:** the honest "retrying" messages persist for several minutes with no recovery
(real backend outage, not a transient blip), or a face-match threshold at the loose end (0.70+)
still rejects the same legitimate person repeatedly — escalate to platform operator.

common_issues.symptom: Kiosk screen is blank/frozen with no message at all
common_issues.diagnosis: Should be fixed as of 2026-07-22 (timeouts + honest messages) — this shouldn't reproduce anymore.
common_issues.fix: Have the user note the exact date/device/browser; try a hard refresh.
common_issues.escalate_when: Reproduces after 2026-07-22 — likely a regression, escalate with device/browser details.

common_issues.symptom: "Can't reach the MetricsPro server" message showing
common_issues.diagnosis: Backend is busy or restarting — this is expected during deploys/traffic spikes and self-retries.
common_issues.fix: Wait — no action needed if it clears within a couple minutes.
common_issues.escalate_when: Message persists for 5+ minutes with no recovery.

common_issues.symptom: Legitimate employee's face doesn't match at clock-in
common_issues.diagnosis: Check Failure Logs for the auto-logged face_mismatch entry (best-match % vs threshold).
common_issues.fix: If rejections are frequent for real reps, raise the tenant's face_match_threshold (Failure Logs page, 0.45–0.72 range, higher = looser).
common_issues.escalate_when: Threshold is already near the loose end and legitimate rejections continue.

common_issues.symptom: Clock-in/out button seemed to hang, unsure if the punch landed
common_issues.diagnosis: A timeout message tells the user to check status before retrying — a blind retry can 409 on an already-open punch.
common_issues.fix: Check the 'on the clock since...' status line first; only retry if status shows NOT clocked in.
common_issues.escalate_when: Status clearly shows the punch didn't land and retrying still fails.

common_issues.symptom: Employee can't clock in at the store they're standing in
common_issues.diagnosis: Not their home/scheduled/floater store today — expected gate, not a bug.
common_issues.fix: A manager uses the on-screen override flow (their own password, throwaway session) to approve the punch.
common_issues.escalate_when: Override flow itself errors for a confirmed manager login.

pages.permissions_needed: Any employee with a portal login linked to an employee record; manager for overrides
related_settings: Clock-in eligibility: home store ∪ scheduled store ∪ floater store (app_users.store_codes)

pages.title: Report Center
pages.user_md:
### What this page shows
A directory of every report/list/dashboard the tenant can access, organized by category. Each entry is a duplicate link to the report's real page - access is identical to the module gates.

### How to use it
Browse by category; click through to any report you have access to.

### Top gotchas
1. You only see reports your role already has access to - a missing report means a role gate, not a broken directory.
2. It's a directory; the actual report opens on its own page.
pages.support_md:
### Data sources
`GET /api/v1/core/portal-reports` + role config. The directory injects each surviving report item (after RBAC/carrier/entitlement filtering) into its category - never a second permission surface.

### Symptom -> diagnosis -> fix
- **A report the user expects isn't listed** -> their role lacks that module/report-area, or a tenant admin hid it. Fix on /admin/roles (or /admin/menu).
- **Directory empty** -> role has no report access.

### Escalation
Role/visibility = support-guidable via /admin/roles. A report that IS granted but still absent = escalate.

### Related settings
/admin/roles, /admin/menu (hide/move + hideReportsDirectory).

common_issues.symptom: A user can't find a report in the Report Center they think they should have.
common_issues.diagnosis: The directory only lists reports the role already passes access for; the module/report-area grant is missing (or the item was hidden on /admin/menu).
common_issues.fix: Grant the module/report area on /admin/roles (or unhide on /admin/menu).
common_issues.escalate_when: The grant is present and the report still doesn't appear anywhere -> escalate to platform operator.

pages.permissions_needed: modules.targets (Report Center entry); each listed report keeps its own module/report-area gate

pages.title: StoreOps Dashboard
pages.user_md:
**What it's for:** the StoreOps home screen — quick tiles (active employees, active stores, this
week's scheduled hours, pending time off) and links into Schedule, Reports, Time Off, Shift Swaps,
Payroll, and Admin.

**When to open a ticket:** if a tile shows 0 or blank when you know there's real data (e.g. "0 active
employees" but people clearly work there), or a tile's link goes nowhere.
pages.support_md:
**Data sources:** `GET /storeops/employees`, `/storeops/stores`, `/storeops/time-off`,
`/storeops/shifts?week_start=...&week_end=...` (current Mon–Sun window, client-computed). Purely a
summary view — no writes happen here.

**Symptom → diagnosis → fix**
- *Tiles all show 0 / dashboard looks "empty" for one tenant only*: almost always correct
  multi-tenant isolation (a newer/smaller tenant genuinely has fewer rows) — verify by checking
  StoreOps Admin directly for that tenant before assuming a bug.
- *A tile's number doesn't match the real page it links to*: the tile uses a plain Mon–Sun window
  regardless of the tenant's configured work-week start (Schedule respects
  `storeops.tenants.work_week_start_dow`, this dashboard doesn't) — a cosmetic mismatch, not a data
  bug; confirm the real page (Schedule/Time Off) is correct.

**Escalate when:** the underlying pages it links to (Schedule, Payroll, Time Off) also show wrong
data — escalate to the platform operator with which page + tenant.

common_issues.symptom: All four tiles show 0 for a tenant that should have data
common_issues.diagnosis: Check StoreOps Admin → Employees/Stores tabs directly for that org — if those are also empty, it's a genuine setup gap (no employees/stores entered yet), not a dashboard bug.
common_issues.fix: Guide the user to StoreOps Admin to add employees/stores, or HR People to add employees.
common_issues.escalate_when: StoreOps Admin shows real employees/stores but this dashboard still shows 0 — escalate to platform operator with org_id.

pages.title: StoreOps Admin (Employees & Stores)
pages.user_md:
**What it's for:** manage the employee roster (name, Emp ID, home store, email, phone, active flag)
and the store list (code, address, market, monthly target, active flag), including bulk
upload/download via Excel template.

**How to use:** edit fields inline, click 💾 to save that row. Use "Bulk add employees/stores" to
download a template, fill it, and re-upload for fast tenant setup. **Pay rate is NOT editable
here** — it moved to HR (see `/hr` → Employees & Pay, or HR · People) to keep pay changes in one
place.

**When to open a ticket:** a save doesn't stick after clicking 💾 (row still shows the old value
after a page refresh), or a bulk upload reports 0 inserted with real rows in the file.
pages.support_md:
**Data sources:** `GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /storeops/employees`, `/storeops/employees/bulk`,
`/storeops/stores`, `/storeops/stores/bulk`. Backend table `storeops.employees` /
`storeops.stores`, schema-qualified.

**Symptom → diagnosis → fix**
- *"Saved" message appears but the row reverts after refresh*: this is the known
  **write-side org-stamping gap** — `storeops.employees`/`storeops.stores` inserts must stamp
  `org_id` to match the scoped read, or new/edited rows can silently vanish for non-house tenants.
  Confirm which tenant (org_id) the user is on.
- *Bulk upload says "0 inserted / N skipped"*: the template needs a `name` (employees) or
  `store_code` (stores) column with a non-blank value per row — a blank name/code is silently
  skipped, not an error. Have the user re-download the template and check for blank first
  columns/extra header rows.
- *Phone won't save*: phone is validated client-side (10-digit US, or `+`-prefixed 11–15 digit
  international) — an invalid format shows an alert with the accepted examples rather than saving.
- *Pay rate field is missing here*: intentional — pay rate lives in **HR** now, not StoreOps Admin
  (see note in the UI). Send the user to `/hr` (Employees & Pay tab) or `/hr/people`.

**Escalate when:** a save 500s outright (not just silently reverting), or a bulk upload errors with
a stack trace instead of an inserted/skipped count — escalate to platform operator with the exact
error and org_id (possible write-side org-stamping regression).

common_issues.symptom: Edited a row, clicked save, saw a success message, but the change didn't stick
common_issues.diagnosis: Confirm the tenant isn't the house org — this is the classic org_id-not-stamped-on-insert/update failure mode for storeops tables.
common_issues.fix: No support-side fix exists (this is a backend write path issue); document the exact row + tenant and escalate.
common_issues.escalate_when: Always — this is a backend fix, not a config or UI issue.

common_issues.symptom: Bulk employee/store upload shows 'Added 0'
common_issues.diagnosis: Check the uploaded file's header row matches the template's exact column names, and that `name`/`store_code` values aren't blank.
common_issues.fix: Have the user re-download the template with the ⬇️ Template button and re-enter data without changing headers.
common_issues.escalate_when: Template-format upload still shows 0 inserted with visibly valid data.

pages.permissions_needed: Admin / StoreOps Admin permission (module `storeops`, typically admin-scoped)
related_settings: Pay rate editing moved to HR module — not a StoreOps Admin setting

pages.title: Employees
pages.user_md:
**What it's for:** a full-roster employee list with inline editing (name, Emp ID, home store, email,
phone, ePay login/salesperson mapping, active flag), search, show-inactive toggle, deactivate,
delete, and **merge duplicates**. Exports to Excel/PDF/email/WhatsApp.

**When to open a ticket:** deleting an employee fails with a "linked records" error and the
deactivate offer also fails, or a merge doesn't move the expected shifts/time-off.
pages.support_md:
**Data sources:** `GET/PATCH/DELETE /storeops/employees`, `/storeops/employees/merge`,
`/core/employees/purge` (mode=deactivate, shared core endpoint — revokes login too).

**Symptom → diagnosis → fix**
- *Delete fails*: the backend blocks deleting an employee with linked shift/time-off history and the
  UI auto-offers **Deactivate** instead (revokes login, keeps history, reversible) — this is
  expected behavior, not a bug.
- *Merge didn't move what I expected*: merge moves **shifts + time-off** only (see the confirmation
  dialog's exact counts) from the duplicate into the target, then removes the duplicate. Other
  history keyed by name (e.g. old reports) is not migrated.
- *ePay login / salesperson fields look wrong*: these are the mapping used to match commission-engine
  data (raw_mi/ePay) to this employee — a wrong value here mis-attributes or zeroes commission for
  that person; this is people-domain-owned but the commission MATCH logic itself is owned by
  mod-commission.

**Escalate when:** deactivate ALSO fails (not just delete), or a merge silently drops shift/time-off
rows instead of moving them (data loss) — escalate to platform operator with employee IDs.

common_issues.symptom: Can't delete an employee — 'linked records' error
common_issues.diagnosis: Expected: they have shift or time-off history tied to their ID.
common_issues.fix: Accept the app's own offer to Deactivate instead (🚫 button) — keeps history, revokes login, reversible.
common_issues.escalate_when: Deactivate also fails with an error.

common_issues.symptom: Merged two duplicate employee rows but pay/commission history for the old one is missing
common_issues.diagnosis: Merge only moves shifts + time-off, not commission/sales history (which is keyed by rep name in the commission engine, not employee_id).
common_issues.fix: Explain the scope of merge; for commission data, escalate to mod-commission with both employee names/IDs.
common_issues.escalate_when: Shifts/time-off themselves didn't move despite the merge confirming a count > 0.

pages.permissions_needed: StoreOps Admin / HR permission to edit employees

pages.title: Hours Budget
pages.user_md:
**What it's for:** set each store's weekly labor-hours budget; the Schedule blocks a manager from
scheduling past it. To exceed it for one week, a manager **requests District Manager approval**
here — the DM approves/denies in-app (recorded, not a config toggle).

**How to use:** pick the week, edit the "Weekly budget (h)" field per store and Save; if a store is
over budget, click **Request DM approval** and the DM (or an admin) approves/denies from the
"Override approvals" panel below.

**When to open a ticket:** a DM approval was granted but the schedule still blocks adding hours, or
a request never reached the DM (no email/notification).
pages.support_md:
**Data sources:** `GET/PUT /storeops/hours-budgets`, `GET/POST /storeops/budget-overrides`,
`POST /storeops/budget-overrides/{id}/decision`. Backed by migration 087. Store/market come from
`storeops.stores`.

**Symptom → diagnosis → fix**
- *Override was approved but scheduling still blocks*: confirm the override's `week_start` matches
  the week actually being scheduled (an override is scoped to ONE store + ONE week — approving last
  week's request does not cover this week).
- *DM never got notified*: the request tries to email the store's District Manager
  (`storeops._dm_for_store`) — if that store has no DM assigned in the **org tree**, the request
  still saves but no email goes out (the UI shows "Requested." without the DM-notified confirmation).
  Check the org tree has a DM assigned to that store's unit.
- *A market/store shows nothing in the filter bar*: the standard filter bar here is store/market only
  (no employee dimension) — an empty result means no budget row exists for that store yet, not a
  filter bug.

**Escalate when:** the override-approval UI itself 500s, or a properly-approved override
(right store, right week) still blocks scheduling — escalate to platform operator.

common_issues.symptom: Approved a budget override but the manager still can't add hours
common_issues.diagnosis: Check the override's week_start vs the week being scheduled — overrides are per-store-per-week, not permanent.
common_issues.fix: Have the manager file a new override request for the correct week if needed.
common_issues.escalate_when: Same store + same week override is approved and still blocked.

common_issues.symptom: Requested DM approval but no notification went out
common_issues.diagnosis: The store likely has no District Manager assigned in the org tree.
common_issues.fix: Assign a DM to that store's org unit (org hierarchy / My Team admin), then re-request.
common_issues.escalate_when: A DM IS assigned and still no email — likely a notify/email config issue, escalate to platform operator.

related_settings: DM assignment via org tree (My Team / org units)

pages.title: Payroll Report
pages.user_md:
**What it's for:** scheduled-vs-actual hours and pay per employee for a chosen month, with universal
store/market/rep filters, and a **posted payroll chargebacks** deduction column (net pay). Full
Excel/PDF/email/WhatsApp export via ReportShell.

**How pay is computed:** `pay = hours × employee's pay rate` (set in HR, not here). **Actual hours**
prefer real clock punches; if a shift was scheduled but nobody clocked actual hours for it yet,
**Actual falls back to Scheduled** for that shift so the report isn't artificially low mid-period.
Separately, a **kiosk clock-in/out with no matching shift at all still counts** — its hours flow in
as Actual with $0 Scheduled (this is what makes payroll non-zero for stores that run mostly on kiosk
punches without formal schedules, e.g. Luxelink).

**When to open a ticket:** an employee is missing from the report entirely, or their pay is $0 while
they clearly worked.
pages.support_md:
**Data sources:** `GET /storeops/payroll?month=YYYY-MM`. Fast path = Postgres RPC
`storeops.payroll_month_rows` (migration 407); legacy Python fallback reads `shifts` + `timelog`
directly if the RPC is missing. Either path implements the SAME two rules:
1. Per shift, `actual_hours == 0` → use `scheduled_hours` instead (mid-period fallback).
2. A **clock punch on a day with no shift row at all** still contributes Actual hours (additive
   timelog fallback — matches "existing platform data shouldn't be silently dropped").
`pay = hours × employees.pay_rate` — **a blank/0 pay_rate produces a $0 pay row even with real
hours.** That's a data problem on the employee record, not a payroll bug.

**Symptom → diagnosis → fix**
- *Employee shows hours but $0 pay*: check their `pay_rate` on the Employees page (StoreOps
  Employees or HR · Employees & Pay) — it's blank or 0. Fix the employee record; the payroll number
  recomputes automatically on next load (nothing to "recalculate").
- *Employee/store missing entirely from the report*: means NEITHER a shift row NOR a closed timelog
  punch exists for them this month. Check the Schedule for missing shifts, or Time Clock to see if
  they ever clocked in. An OPEN (not clocked out) punch does not count — only closed punches.
- *"No shifts or clock-ins recorded" empty state*: genuinely no data for that month from either
  source — verify in Schedule and Time Clock before assuming a bug.
- *Store attribution looks wrong for a floater*: a floater's row attributes to whichever store they
  worked the MOST hours at that month (dominant store), not their static home store — this is
  intentional, not a bug.
- *A store/market/rep filter returns nothing*: confirm the filter values actually exist in this
  month's data — the filter narrows the ALREADY-loaded rows (empty ≠ broken).

**Escalate when:** pay_rate is confirmed correct and hours are confirmed correct but the computed
pay is still wrong (math bug), or the page 500s / times out on load — money-adjacent, escalate to
platform operator immediately with employee_id + month.

common_issues.symptom: Employee shows hours worked but $0.00 pay
common_issues.diagnosis: Their pay_rate is blank or 0 on the employee record — payroll math is hours × pay_rate with no other fallback.
common_issues.fix: Set the correct pay_rate on StoreOps Employees or HR → Employees & Pay, then reload the Payroll Report (no recalculation step needed).
common_issues.escalate_when: pay_rate is confirmed set correctly and the row still shows $0 pay.

common_issues.symptom: An employee who definitely worked (kiosk clock-in) is missing from the report
common_issues.diagnosis: Check Time Clock (/storeops/timeclock) for that employee/date — if the punch is still OPEN (no clock-out), it doesn't count yet; if there's no punch at all, they never clocked in.
common_issues.fix: Have them clock out properly, or add a manual-hours adjustment on the Time Clock admin page for a missed punch.
common_issues.escalate_when: A closed punch with hours clearly exists in Time Clock but still doesn't appear here.

common_issues.symptom: Total payroll dollar figures look wrong for the month
common_issues.diagnosis: Money-adjacent — verify hours and pay_rate are individually correct first; this may be a calculation-engine issue.
common_issues.fix: Do not attempt a workaround; this is propose-first, money-touching territory.
common_issues.escalate_when: Always, once hours/pay_rate are confirmed correct and the total still looks wrong.

pages.permissions_needed: Manager/admin with StoreOps or HR payroll view access
related_settings: Failure Logs / face-match unrelated to this page

pages.title: Payroll (with Tax)
pages.user_md:
**What it's for:** an **estimate** payroll run with FICA (Social Security + Medicare), flat federal,
and state withholding, per employee, over a date range — with an editable per-employee W-4 (filing
status, allowances, state, extra withholding, flat-22%-federal toggle) and a printable pay slip.
Clearly labeled **estimate (flat-rate)** — not a substitute for a real payroll provider.

**When to open a ticket:** withholding numbers look wrong for a state that IS supported, or the page
says "run migration 045" when other payroll pages work fine.
pages.support_md:
**Data sources:** `GET /storeops/payroll-raw?start&end` (raw hours + rate + W-4 settings),
`GET/PUT /storeops/payroll-settings/{employee_id}` (per-employee W-4). Tax math lives client-side in
`lib/payroll-tax.ts` (`computePay`, `TAX_RATES`).

**Symptom → diagnosis → fix**
- *State shows "$0 est." next to it in the W-4 dropdown*: that state has no configured SIT rate in
  `TAX_RATES.state_sit` — the row title on the dropdown option literally flags this
  ("rate not configured"), so $0 state withholding for that state is a known gap, not a bug, for
  states outside the seeded 8 (NY/NJ/DE/PA/IL/CT/MA/IN).
- *"scheduled est." badge next to an employee's hours*: no clock punches exist for them in this date
  range — the row falls back to their entered SCHEDULE hours as an estimate. Have them clock in, or
  treat the number as an estimate only.
- *"Load failed (run migration 045?)"*: this page needs migration 045 — if OTHER payroll pages
  (Payroll Report, StoreOps Reports) work fine, this is likely a stale/unrelated error message, not
  an actual missing migration; escalate to confirm the migration status rather than guessing.

**Escalate when:** the "run migration 045" message persists across page reloads and other
storeops payroll pages ALSO error — escalate to platform operator to confirm pending SQL for this
tenant's environment.

common_issues.symptom: State withholding shows $0 for a state the tenant actually operates in
common_issues.diagnosis: That state isn't in the app's configured state-tax-rate table (only NY/NJ/DE/PA/IL/CT/MA/IN are seeded).
common_issues.fix: This is a config gap, not a bug — note the missing state for the platform-core/finance team; there's no in-app way to add a new state's rate yet.
common_issues.escalate_when: Always, for a genuinely new state — needs a code/config change, not a settings toggle.

common_issues.symptom: Page shows 'Load failed (run migration 045?)' even though Payroll Report works
common_issues.diagnosis: Likely unrelated to an actual missing migration if sibling payroll pages work.
common_issues.fix: None client-side.
common_issues.escalate_when: Always — confirm migration status with platform operator before telling the user anything is missing.

related_settings: Per-employee W-4 (filing status, allowances, state, extra withholding)

pages.title: StoreOps Reports — Hours & Payroll
pages.user_md:
**What it's for:** the same scheduled-vs-actual hours/pay data as the Payroll Report, viewable
**by employee** or **by store**, with summary tiles and full export.

**When to open a ticket:** by-store totals don't match the sum of by-employee rows for the same
store.
pages.support_md:
**Data sources:** `GET /storeops/payroll?month=YYYY-MM` (same endpoint as `/storeops/payroll`) +
`GET /storeops/stores` for market lookup. The by-store view is a client-side rollup (`Object.values`
reduce) of the SAME rows the by-employee view shows — they should always foot to the same totals.

**Symptom → diagnosis → fix**
- *By-store total ≠ sum of by-employee rows for that store*: since both views derive from the exact
  same payroll rows client-side, a mismatch usually means the page was viewed mid-load (switch tabs
  and re-check) — genuine data bugs here would also show up on `/storeops/payroll`.
- *Empty for the month*: same root causes as the Payroll Report (no shifts AND no clock punches yet)
  — see that page's support notes.

**Escalate when:** the mismatch persists after a hard refresh, or numbers here disagree with
`/storeops/payroll` for the identical month — escalate with both screenshots.

common_issues.symptom: Store rollup total doesn't match employee-level rows for that store
common_issues.diagnosis: Both views come from the same data client-side; try a hard refresh first.
common_issues.fix: Hard-refresh and re-check; if it persists, capture both view screenshots for the same month.
common_issues.escalate_when: Mismatch survives a hard refresh.

pages.title: Schedule
pages.user_md:
**What it's for:** build/edit the weekly shift schedule, by store or by employee, with multi-market
filtering, double-booking + coverage-gap warnings, copy-last-week / copy-forward-N-weeks, and
save/apply recurring weekly templates. Full export + Send.

**How to use:** click any day cell to add a shift (or click an existing chip to edit its times);
"Today" snaps the grid to the current work week using the tenant's configured work-week start day
(not always Monday). Approved time off shows as an 🌴 OFF badge and blocks new shifts that day.

**When to open a ticket:** a shift add is silently rejected, or a store/employee doesn't appear in
the picker/grid at all.
pages.support_md:
**Data sources:** `GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /storeops/shifts`, `/storeops/employees` (span-scoped for
the grid, `all_company=true` for the add-shift picker so a floater outside the manager's own span
can still be added), `/storeops/stores`, `/storeops/time-off`, `/storeops/shift-templates/*`,
`GET /core/tenant-settings` for `work_week_start_dow`.

**Symptom → diagnosis → fix**
- *Adding a shift 409s / "Could not add shift"*: the backend blocks a shift on a day the employee has
  **approved time off** — this is by design (see the 🌴 OFF badge on that cell). Check Time Off for
  that employee/date before assuming a bug.
- *Grid doesn't line up with the tenant's real pay week (e.g. starts Monday but should start
  Thursday)*: the grid snaps to `storeops.tenants.work_week_start_dow` on load — if it's still
  wrong, confirm that tenant setting is actually configured (not just assumed).
- *An employee/store is missing from the picker*: the grid itself is **span-scoped** (a manager only
  sees their own team/stores) but the ADD-SHIFT dropdown pulls the **whole company roster**
  (`all_company=true`) so floaters can be scheduled anywhere — if even the add-shift picker is
  missing someone, check they're marked `is_active` on StoreOps Admin/Employees.
- *Double-booking / coverage-gap banner shows something that looks wrong*: double-booking = same
  employee, same day, 2+ stores; coverage gaps only flag stores ALREADY in this week's rotation with
  an uncovered day — a store simply not scheduled at all this week is correctly NOT flagged.
- *"Copy weeks" / "Copy last week" skipped some shifts*: duplicates are intentionally skipped
  (same employee + date + start time already exists) — check the alert's added-count vs. expected.

**Escalate when:** a shift add fails with an error OTHER than the time-off 409 (e.g. a raw 500), or
shifts silently don't save even without a time-off conflict — this is the storeops
write-side-org-stamping failure mode, escalate immediately with the exact employee/store/date.

common_issues.symptom: Can't add a shift — 'Could not add shift' or a 409-style error
common_issues.diagnosis: Check whether the employee has approved time off on that date (look for the 🌴 OFF badge on the cell).
common_issues.fix: This is by design — either pick a different date or have the time-off request revoked/denied first if it was entered in error.
common_issues.escalate_when: No time-off conflict exists and the add still fails.

common_issues.symptom: Schedule week doesn't start on the tenant's actual pay-week day
common_issues.diagnosis: storeops.tenants.work_week_start_dow may not be set for this tenant.
common_issues.fix: Confirm/set the tenant's work-week start day (0=Mon..6=Sun) with the platform operator — no in-app self-service UI for this setting yet.
common_issues.escalate_when: Always — this is a config value only the operator can currently set.

common_issues.symptom: A newly-added shift disappears after saving
common_issues.diagnosis: Possible org_id-not-stamped write-side bug (known storeops failure mode).
common_issues.fix: None client-side — capture employee/store/date and tenant.
common_issues.escalate_when: Always — backend fix required.

pages.permissions_needed: Manager/admin with schedule-edit access; view may be span-scoped by role

pages.title: Shift Extensions
pages.user_md:
**What it's for:** employees are **automatically clocked out at their scheduled shift end** — to
keep someone longer, a manager files an extension request **ahead of time**, and the District
Manager approves/denies it in-app. Filing ahead of time is the ONLY way to avoid the automatic
clock-out.

**When to open a ticket:** an approved extension didn't stop the automatic clock-out at the
original scheduled end time.
pages.support_md:
**Data sources:** `GET/POST /storeops/shift-extensions`, `POST /storeops/shift-extensions/{id}/decision`.
Migration 086. The force-clockout job (`_do_force_clockout`, run via
`/timeclock/force-clockout/run-due`) checks `_approved_extension_end` before force-closing a punch.

**Symptom → diagnosis → fix**
- *Employee got auto-clocked-out despite an "approved" extension*: check the extension's
  `shift_date` and `requested_end` match the ACTUAL shift being worked — an extension approved for
  the wrong date, or submitted AFTER the force-clockout job already ran for that scheduled end, has
  no effect. Extensions must be filed and approved **before** the original scheduled end passes.
- *DM never got notified of a pending request*: same root cause as Hours Budget overrides — the
  store needs a District Manager assigned in the org tree for the notification email to fire; the
  request itself still saves either way.

**Escalate when:** a correctly-dated, pre-approved extension still gets force-clocked-out at the
original time — escalate to platform operator with the extension ID + employee + date (possible
force-clockout job bug).

common_issues.symptom: Employee was auto-clocked-out even though a manager approved an extension
common_issues.diagnosis: Check the extension request was filed AND approved before the original scheduled end time, and the date/time match the actual shift.
common_issues.fix: File a new extension well before the scheduled end next time; there's no way to retroactively un-clock-out.
common_issues.escalate_when: The extension was clearly approved in time with matching date/time and the auto-clockout still happened.

related_settings: Force-clockout grace period (backend constant, not user-configurable)

pages.title: Shift Swaps
pages.user_md:
**What it's for:** request and approve shift swaps between two employees. Approving a swap
**reassigns the actual shift(s)** — it's not just a status label.

**When to open a ticket:** approving a swap didn't actually move the shift on the Schedule.
pages.support_md:
**Data sources:** `GET/POST /storeops/shift-swaps`, `PATCH /storeops/shift-swaps/{id}` (status),
`/storeops/employees`, `/storeops/shifts` (a ±7/+21 day window around today for the shift pickers).

**Symptom → diagnosis → fix**
- *Approved but the Schedule still shows the old assignment*: confirm the request actually included
  a `shift_id` (the employee's shift to give up) — a swap request created WITHOUT picking a specific
  shift (both shift fields left as "optional") has nothing concrete to reassign; check what the
  request's "Gives up" / "Their shift" columns actually show.
- *A shift doesn't appear in the requester's/target's shift picker*: the picker only lists shifts in
  a ±7 day / +21 day window from today — a swap for a shift outside that window won't show it (has
  to be created closer to the date, or ask an admin to move it manually on Schedule instead).

**Escalate when:** a swap with BOTH shift IDs populated was approved and neither employee's shift
moved on the Schedule — escalate to platform operator with the swap ID.

common_issues.symptom: Approved a shift swap but the Schedule page still shows the original assignment
common_issues.diagnosis: Check whether the swap request actually specified shift_id/target_shift_id — a swap with no shift attached has nothing to reassign.
common_issues.fix: Have the manager edit the shift directly on the Schedule page instead, or re-create the swap with both shifts selected.
common_issues.escalate_when: Both shifts were specified and approval still didn't reassign them.

pages.title: My Team
pages.user_md:
**What it's for:** a manager's rolled-up performance view (stores + reps under them) for the
selected period, shared with the "My Team" tab on the mobile /portal. Admins can pick any org unit
from the Scope dropdown to view a different part of the org.

**When to open a ticket:** the page shows no data at all for a manager who should see their team, or
"All Markets"/a specific market shows nothing.
pages.support_md:
**Data sources:** `GET /storeops/org/tree` (units + levels) + `<TeamSnapshot>` component (scoped by
the caller's token, or by `unit_id` when an admin picks a unit).

**Symptom → diagnosis → fix**
- *Manager sees nothing under "my team"*: their **org-tree placement** likely doesn't include any
  units/stores yet — a manager must be assigned to a unit in the org tree (Admin → Org) for their
  own span to resolve to anything. This is the single most common "empty manager view" cause.
- *Picking a market by name shows nothing*: **a market string label never grants access by itself.**
  Real "see everything" access comes from being placed at the ROOT of the org tree, or a role scope
  of `all` — a market/store NAME match against `stores.market` only works if that exact string is
  how the org tree/roles are actually configured. Verify the manager's real scope (org tree
  placement or `permissions.scope`), not just what label they picked.

**Escalate when:** the manager IS correctly placed in the org tree (confirmed via Admin → Org) and
still sees empty data — escalate to platform operator with the manager's user + intended unit.

common_issues.symptom: A manager's My Team page is empty
common_issues.diagnosis: Check the org tree (Admin → Org) — is this manager actually assigned to any unit/store?
common_issues.fix: Assign the manager to the correct org unit; the page then resolves their span automatically.
common_issues.escalate_when: Manager is correctly placed in the org tree and the page is still empty.

common_issues.symptom: "All Markets" or a specific market name shows nobody
common_issues.diagnosis: A market label is not itself a permission — real all-market access requires root org-tree placement or role scope 'all'.
common_issues.fix: Check/replace the manager's org-tree placement or role scope rather than relying on the market label.
common_issues.escalate_when: Org-tree placement and role scope both look correct and it's still empty.

pages.permissions_needed: Any manager (own span) / admin (any unit via Scope picker)

pages.title: Time Clock (admin)
pages.user_md:
**What it's for:** review employee clock punches — in/out time, hours, store, face-match %, GPS map
link, and selfie thumbnail — plus add manual-hours adjustments (with a required reason). The
employee-facing clock-in itself happens on the mobile **kiosk (`/portal`)**, not here.

**Times shown are in the business timezone (America/New_York by default)** regardless of the
viewer's own browser timezone, so this report always matches what the kiosk showed the employee.

**When to open a ticket:** a punch is missing entirely, hours look wrong for a punch that clearly
has both an in and out time, or a face-match % looks surprisingly low for a legitimate employee.
pages.support_md:
**Data sources:** `GET /storeops/timeclock/list?start&end&employee_id`, manual adjustments via
`GET/POST/DELETE /storeops/manual-hours`. Punch rows live in `storeops.timelog`, written in
`BUSINESS_TZ=America/New_York` — this was a deliberate fix for a kiosk-vs-report mismatch; **do not
"simplify" this back to UTC**, that regresses the bug.

**Symptom → diagnosis → fix**
- *A face-match % looks low (e.g. under 60%) for someone HR insists is the right person*: check
  **Failure Logs** (`/failures`, platform-core owned) — a rejected face match auto-logs a
  `face_mismatch` row there with a how-to-fix note. The tenant's face-match threshold is
  configurable (`storeops.tenants.face_match_threshold`, default 0.60, clamp 0.45–0.72) —
  **higher = looser = fewer false rejects**; if legitimate reps are getting rejected often, that
  threshold may need raising (done on the Failure Logs page, not here).
- *"No punches in range. (Run migration 045 if this errors.)"*: only relevant if the query
  genuinely 500s — an empty-but-successful result just means no punches in that date range/filter.
- *Hours look wrong for a punch with both in and out times*: hours are computed server-side at
  clock-out; a manual-hours adjustment can correct a specific date (with a mandatory reason logged)
  rather than editing the punch itself (punches aren't directly editable here).
- *Punch shows "open" indefinitely (employee clearly left)*: a forgotten clock-out — either wait for
  the automatic force-clockout job (runs near scheduled shift end, honors any approved shift
  extension) or add a manual-hours adjustment to correct that day's total.

**Escalate when:** a punch is missing from the list even though the employee insists they clocked in
AND `/portal` showed them a success message — escalate to platform operator with employee_id + exact
time (possible dropped-write on the storeops write path).

common_issues.symptom: Legitimate employee's face-match % keeps coming back low / they keep getting rejected at the kiosk
common_issues.diagnosis: Face-match threshold (storeops.tenants.face_match_threshold, default 0.60) may be too strict for this tenant/lighting conditions; check Failure Logs for the face_mismatch entries and their recorded distance/threshold.
common_issues.fix: Raise the tenant's face_match_threshold (higher = looser) on the Failure Logs page, within the 0.45–0.72 allowed range. Also consider having the employee re-register their face if lighting/appearance changed a lot.
common_issues.escalate_when: Threshold is already at/near the loose end (0.70+) and rejections continue for the same person — may need a face-model or hardware look, escalate to platform operator.

common_issues.symptom: A punch is completely missing even though the employee says they clocked in successfully
common_issues.diagnosis: Confirm from the employee whether they saw a clear success confirmation on the kiosk, or a timeout/error message.
common_issues.fix: Have them check their own /portal status (it shows 'on the clock since...' if it landed) before assuming data loss; if status also shows nothing, escalate.
common_issues.escalate_when: Kiosk showed success or an ambiguous timeout message and the punch never appears in Time Clock — likely a dropped write, escalate with employee_id + timestamp.

related_settings: Face-match threshold (storeops.tenants.face_match_threshold) — set on Failure Logs page

pages.title: Time Off Requests
pages.user_md:
**What it's for:** submit and approve/deny time-off requests (PTO/Sick/Unpaid/Personal). A manager
entering a request can approve it immediately ("manager entry") or leave it pending for someone else
to approve. **Approved time off blocks new shifts on the Schedule for those dates.**

**When to open a ticket:** the request list is empty/missing entries for a manager who should see
requests for their team, or approving a request didn't block the Schedule as expected.
pages.support_md:
**Data sources:** `GET/POST/PATCH /storeops/time-off`, `/storeops/employees`. Dates use
`parseLocalDate` (local-safe) for day-count math — this page is one of the fixed spots for the
"`new Date('YYYY-MM-DD')` parses as UTC" off-by-one bug; other pages/reports may still have it.

**Symptom → diagnosis → fix**
- *A request's displayed dates are off by one day from what was submitted*: this specific page uses
  the safe local-date parser, so if you see an off-by-one here, screenshot it exactly — it may
  indicate a regression, unlike some other reports which are already known to have this bug.
- *Manager sees no time-off requests at all*: check their org-tree/span placement (same root cause
  as an empty My Team page) — a manager with no unit assignment sees nobody's requests.
- *Approved a request but a shift still got added on that date*: the block only applies going
  forward from when the shift is entered — a shift ADDED before the time off was approved is not
  retroactively removed; check whether the shift predates the approval.

**Escalate when:** dates are visibly off-by-one on THIS page (it's supposed to be fixed here), or
approving doesn't block new Schedule entries for a request created after the fact.

common_issues.symptom: Manager's time-off list is empty
common_issues.diagnosis: Check their org-tree placement — same as the My Team empty-view root cause.
common_issues.fix: Assign the manager to the correct org unit.
common_issues.escalate_when: Org-tree placement looks correct and the list is still empty.

common_issues.symptom: Dates shown are one day off from what was submitted
common_issues.diagnosis: This page uses the fixed local-date parser, so an off-by-one here is unexpected — capture exact input/output.
common_issues.fix: None client-side.
common_issues.escalate_when: Always, for this specific page — likely a regression.

pages.title: Store Visits — List
pages.user_md:
## What this page shows
Every DM store visit (in-progress and submitted), filterable by market/store, exportable. "Start visit" begins a new visit; "Checklist" (admin-only) opens the checklist item editor.

## When to open a ticket
- No visits show at all despite DMs actively doing them.
pages.support_md:
## Data source
`GET /storevisit/visits`, `GET /storevisit/stores`. No server-side market/store restriction is applied here beyond the frontend's own filter defaulting to the logged-in DM's market — unlike /closing/summary, this list endpoint doesn't enforce `scope_keyset` server-side.

## Escalate when
- A market-scoped DM reports seeing visits from other markets in the raw list (only filterable, not server-restricted) and this is considered a problem for this tenant — escalate to mod-people (owns this frontend tree) alongside retail-ops (owns the /storevisit backend).

common_issues.symptom: No visits appear even though DMs report doing them
common_issues.diagnosis: A lingering market/store filter is narrowing the list, or visits genuinely haven't been started yet.
common_issues.fix: Clear the market/store filters (✕ Clear button).
common_issues.escalate_when: Filters are cleared and known-completed visits still don't appear.

common_issues.symptom: "Checklist" admin link is missing
common_issues.diagnosis: Requires company-wide scope or the admin module — a plain DM role won't see it.
common_issues.fix: Grant company-wide scope or the admin module if this user needs to edit the checklist.
common_issues.escalate_when: N/A — role-permission fix.

common_issues.symptom: A store visit was submitted but doesn't appear in the list
common_issues.diagnosis: Open the visit detail page directly by its ID if known, or check whether it was truly submitted vs left as a draft.
common_issues.fix: Have the DM re-open the visit from wherever they left it and click 'Check out & submit' again.
common_issues.escalate_when: Visit detail page confirms status=submitted but it's absent from this list — escalate to mod-retail-ops (backend owner of storevisit).
