pages.permissions_needed: Store Visits module entitlement to view; the "Checklist" (settings) link additionally requires company-wide scope or the admin module.

pages.title: Store Visit Detail — Action Items & Sign-off
pages.user_md:
## What this page shows
A completed or in-progress visit's full record: header info (market/DM/times/GPS/scheduled-vs-actual rep), the inspection checklist responses, accessories to order (with the tenant-configured or default distributor link), extra notes, and the clean-store photo. **Phase 2 of the DM store visit** lives at the top: the store's auto-generated Daily Targets/DLAR action items for that month are rolled up here — check off which were discussed, add a comment, attach proof photos — then build an **agreed action plan** for the rep (description + due date), and capture **rep + DM sign-off**. You can also upload a scan of the printed-and-physically-signed checklist.

## When to open a ticket
- "No action items for this store" when you know the store has flagged metrics that month.
- Sign-off keeps prompting for a name every time instead of remembering it.
pages.support_md:
## Data source
`GET /storevisit/visits/{id}` for the visit record; the Action Items panel (`VisitActions.tsx`) pulls the LIVE rolled-up items from the EXISTING `GET /commcalc/targets/{period}/action-plan` engine (mod-commission-owned, Daily Targets module) for that store/month, then merges the DM's own saved overlay (`GET/PUT /storevisit/visits/{id}/action-items`) on top. The rolled-up items are auto-seeded onto the visit's own overlay the FIRST time this page is opened (fire-and-forget) so they're persisted per-visit even if the underlying engine's output changes later.

## "Daily closing + B2B recon" as the visit's 3rd phase
The domain's third phase (per the DM store-visit design) is conceptually the store's Daily Closing dashboard/recon — a DM reviewing a store during a visit is expected to also check that store's closing/recon health (e.g. via /closing/verify, /closing/recon) as part of the same overall workflow; this isn't rendered as a literal tab inside the visit-detail page itself.

## Escalate when
- "No action items for this store" when Daily Targets/DLAR data is confirmed loaded and flagged for that store/month — escalate to mod-commission (the action-plan engine itself).
- The rolled-up items differ from what the Daily Targets page shows for the same store/month — escalate to mod-commission (source-of-truth mismatch).

common_issues.symptom: "No action items for this store" in this month
common_issues.diagnosis: The Daily Targets/DLAR action-plan engine has nothing for that store/month yet — DLAR and targets haven't been loaded/calculated for the period, or the store genuinely has no flagged items.
common_issues.fix: Confirm DLAR + Daily Targets are loaded for the period (mod-commission module); if they are and the store should have flags, escalate.
common_issues.escalate_when: DLAR/targets are confirmed loaded for the period and flagged items exist elsewhere but don't show here.

common_issues.symptom: Sign-off asks for a name via a browser prompt every single time
common_issues.diagnosis: By design — there's no persisted default name; typing into the "Rep name" box before clicking Sign off avoids the prompt for the rep signature (DM sign-off always uses the logged-in DM's name if available).
common_issues.fix: Fill in the Rep name field first before clicking the sign-off button.
common_issues.escalate_when: N/A — expected behaviour.

common_issues.symptom: Signed checklist scan from a previous visit doesn't show on a new visit
common_issues.diagnosis: By design — the signed-checklist upload is per-visit, each new visit needs its own scan.
common_issues.fix: Upload a fresh scan for the new visit.
common_issues.escalate_when: N/A.

common_issues.symptom: Visit detail page says 'Visit not found'
common_issues.diagnosis: Confirm the visit ID in the URL is correct; check the visits list for the actual ID.
common_issues.fix: Navigate from /storeops/visits list rather than a possibly-stale bookmarked link.
common_issues.escalate_when: The visit clearly exists in the list (clickable) but its own detail page 404s.

pages.title: New Store Visit — Check-in & Inspection Checklist
pages.user_md:
## What this page shows
**Phase 1 of the DM store visit.** Pick market/store/date, tap **Check in** to capture GPS + timestamp, then confirm which rep is actually on duty (vs the schedule — a mismatch prompts for a reason). Work through the inspection checklist (grouped by category: Appearance, Facilities, Security, Supplies, Accessories, Other) — check each item, add a note, attach a photo. List accessories that need reordering (with a link to order them). Add any other notes and a clean-store photo. **Save draft** to continue later, or **Check out & submit** to finish.

## When to open a ticket
- GPS never captures on a device where location services are clearly enabled.
- The "actual rep" picker is empty.
pages.support_md:
## Data source
`POST /storevisit/visits` (check-in), `PATCH /storevisit/visits/{id}` (save draft), `POST /storevisit/visits/{id}/submit` (check out). Checklist items come from `GET /storevisit/checklist-items` — admin-configurable at `/storeops/visits/settings`. The "actual rep" picker uses the FULL company employee roster (not just the DM's own scope), since a floater can legitimately be working a store outside the DM's normal span.

## GPS is best-effort, never blocking
A denied permission or unsupported device shows a warning message but does not prevent completing the visit — `check_in_lat/lng/accuracy` are simply left null.

## Known hardcode gap
The "Order accessories" button on THIS page is a local hardcoded `VACCESSORIZE_URL` constant — it does NOT read the tenant's `/closing/store-visit-config` override yet (the visit-DETAIL page's equivalent button is already wired correctly). This is a documented, known follow-up owned by mod-people (this file's frontend owner), not something to attempt fixing per-tenant.

## Escalate when
- GPS fails on a device confirmed to have location services on and permission granted for the browser — likely a device/browser issue, not app-side.
- The employee roster fetch (`/storeops/employees?all_company=true`) is failing — escalate to mod-people.

common_issues.symptom: GPS shows "Location unavailable"
common_issues.diagnosis: Browser denied location permission, or the device has no/poor GPS signal.
common_issues.fix: Grant location permission in the browser; the visit can be completed without GPS regardless (non-blocking).
common_issues.escalate_when: Confirmed permission is granted and GPS still consistently fails.

common_issues.symptom: "Actual rep present" picker is empty
common_issues.diagnosis: The company-wide employee roster fetch failed or returned nothing.
common_issues.fix: Refresh the page; check that the employee roster loads correctly elsewhere in the app.
common_issues.escalate_when: The roster is confirmed populated elsewhere and still empty here — escalate to mod-people.

common_issues.symptom: "Order accessories" button points to vAccessorize.com even though this tenant configured its own distributor link
common_issues.diagnosis: Known gap — this specific page's button is a separate hardcoded constant, not yet wired to /closing/store-visit-config (unlike the visit-detail page).
common_issues.fix: No tenant-side fix currently; the visit-detail page after submission shows the correct configured link.
common_issues.escalate_when: Flag to mod-people as the known documented follow-up.

common_issues.symptom: GPS won't capture and the DM can't get past check-in
common_issues.diagnosis: GPS failure is intentionally non-blocking — the check-in button is not disabled by a GPS error.
common_issues.fix: Have the DM proceed without location (it just won't have a GPS pin) or check their device's location permission.
common_issues.escalate_when: The Check-in button itself is unresponsive with no GPS-related message at all.

pages.permissions_needed: Store Visits module entitlement — used by DMs/District Managers.

pages.title: Store Visit Checklist Settings
pages.user_md:
## What this page shows
Admin-only editor for the inspection checklist item bank used on every new store visit: add an item (label, category, sort order), edit labels/categories/sort inline, and Deactivate/Reactivate items. Deactivating an item removes it from FUTURE new visits only — visits that already captured a response for it keep that response untouched.

## When to open a ticket
- A newly-added checklist item doesn't show up on a visit that was already checked in before you added it (this is expected — see below — but confirm before assuming it's fine).
pages.support_md:
## Data source
`GET/POST/PATCH/DELETE /storevisit/checklist-items` (`storeops.checklist_items`). DELETE is really a soft-deactivate (`is_active=false`) so historical visit responses keep their item snapshots intact — nothing is ever hard-deleted from this UI.

## New items don't retroactively appear on open visits
A visit already checked in before a new checklist item was added won't show that item — checklist items are captured as of when the visit's checklist is rendered/saved, not re-synced live. This is expected, not a bug.

## Escalate when
- An item that should have been soft-deactivated (still shows on new visits after clicking Deactivate) — escalate to mod-people.

common_issues.symptom: Accidentally deleted a checklist item
common_issues.diagnosis: DELETE only sets is_active=false — nothing is actually destroyed.
common_issues.fix: Click Reactivate on the item to restore it immediately.
common_issues.escalate_when: N/A — always recoverable.

common_issues.symptom: A newly-added item isn't showing on a visit that's already in progress
common_issues.diagnosis: By design — new items only apply going forward to newly checked-in visits.
common_issues.fix: N/A — expected; the item will appear on the NEXT new visit.
common_issues.escalate_when: The item still doesn't appear on a genuinely NEW visit started after it was added.

common_issues.symptom: Renamed a checklist item but past visit reports still show the old wording
common_issues.diagnosis: By design — each visit snapshots the label text at submission time.
common_issues.fix: No action needed; explain the snapshot behavior to the user.
common_issues.escalate_when: N/A — not a bug.

pages.permissions_needed: Company-wide scope or the admin module (gated client-side as `isAdmin` — company-wide scope OR `modules.admin`).
